items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: That was Saxie Dowell. I don’t know whether that name rings a bill — he was a saxophone player with Hal Kemp for years

ctx.x: What band was that? Was that one of the early groups?

That was a band that originated at the University of North Carolina. That’s where I went after my freshman year in college of Davison. I transferred there — because they had a much bigger school there, they also had a music school, which I didn’t go. But they had campus bands, like that’s where Hal Kemp first started. And it’s also where Kay Kyser came from. And more opportunity to play. By this time I really wanted to play, and on the campus, when I transferred there as a sophomore, there was a trumpet — the…
Did you kind of give up college to go out and pursue your music?
